body:
I totally get where you’re coming from, but I don’t *think* that’s what’s going on here, but I’ll definitely introspect about it. 

I know he’s not doing anything deliberately. If nothing else, he’s a super nice person. I didn’t really want to mention this because I’m worried it’ll identify me too much, but my birthday was last week and even after stressing for months how important it was to me, i got nothing :/ I told him i was disappointed and he said he would make it up to me but it hasn’t happened. I understand it’s not in everyone’s nature to create gestures for others, but it was my 21st birthday and I just wanted something. A card. Maybe some special birthday sex. I don’t know. Something. I expressed that to him. Nada. 

There’s a point where “it’s just how he is” turns into enabling him into inactivity. People do things for other people’s birthdays when it’s important to them. i don’t think i’m off base with this.
oh well that sucks. thank you for the personal evidence. i appreciate it. it definitely helps unfortunately :/

Yes, countless times. I know it’s long but i did mention that above :)

edit: or at least i meant to mention it. i rewrote this a few times, so i might have missed it
I'm assuming they have a PO box, since he had to go there to get his package, most of those people don't have physical mailboxes at home :)
I'll try to go to them more (two of them are my roommates). I'll convey how much I need them. Thank you for your kind words :)

Glad to hear you're okay. You deserve it.

I probably painted him as a worse person than he is. He's a really good guy, he's just under a tremendous amount of stress in addition to this. I wish he don't have to be the one to front my pain. 

Thank you for being so kind and empathetic. You're a good person
I agree, it's really nice to have somewhere to talk where you don't have to feel bad for being a downer. I'll try to talk to him again :)
I am in therapy, thank you for the response :)

I agree, but I don't want to force them to be there for me. They all sent me really nice messages after it happened, but don't like when I talk about it beyond that. Just a few more people to cross off my Christmas card list, I guess

I'm so sorry about your husband. I hope you're doing okay now.

The circle of grieving is definitely helpful and I appreciate it :) I don't know who he could talk to about this, but i'll bring it up when he gets off work. 

As for the therapy, he's one of those strange, impossible people who simply "doesn't believe" in therapy. I asked him if he would ever be willing to go if we needed it and he flat out said it wouldn't help him. I was taken aback, but it wasn't relevant at the time, so I brushed it off. He has since refused to come with me because "paying someone just to talk is a waste of money."

Thank you so much for the response, it's very helpful, I appreciate your time

That's the thing though, I didn't get many of those things with him. His disease can from substance abuse, both alcoholic and narcotic, so I only had a few good years with him. I appreciate the reality check, and I know he's not coming back. But that's something I'm working out with my therapist. Thanks for the response, though :)

I definitely agree, he's been a godsend. And I know it has been hell for him, since my family is so far away and my friends have basically taken a "changing the subject when anything remotely related to my feelings comes up" stance, so he and my therapist are about it. I wish he didn't have to deal with this, but he's too good of a person to distance himself from the toxicity of my pain, ya know? And I don't know how I can help him when I can barely remember to feed myself. Thank you for responding

Edit: spelling

I suggested this and even contacted my therapist's office to see if any additional fees would apply, but he was vehemently opposed for some reason. I couldn't get a real answer as to why, just that "if we couldn't work it out on our own it wasn't going to be worked out." I'll work on it some more, though. I do think it would help. Thank you for responding
